exclusions: Geometric QEM is not promised to preserve UV seams; this fixture tests the hard seam contract.

oracle.derivation: Two charts meet at x=0.5 with duplicated corners. Chart 101 has tangent_w=+1, chart 202 has tangent_w=-1. Bitangent = w * cross(n, t); averaging across the seam would flip a chart.
oracle.not_derived_from: Hypermedia compute_mikktspace output or QualiaDB uv_atlas

tolerances.near_zero_policy: Distinguish absolute and relative error. A residual is near-zero only if |r| <= 1e-15 * nonzero_reference_scale or r is an exact integer zero.

provenance: Original analytic construction; no imported dataset; oracle values are closed-form or exact-integer and are not derived from QualiaDB/Etalon/Hypermedia implementation helpers
spec_exposure: UV seams, tiled/checker textures, normal maps, tangent handedness
